dispatches only the selected ownership and confirms only its watcher observation

GameLaunchTests.Collapsed_game_attribute.reason: The native grouped tile prefers the installed second copy; both Details presentations retain the grouped title and selected ownership. The real HTTP action service dispatches steam://run/20, declares only that ownership's intent before URI dispatch, suppresses duplicate starts, and publishes its watcher observation. Native fixture dispatch is recorded without starting a real game.

Details focuses without dispatch, launches the selected copy and resolves only its watcher signal

GameLaunchTests.The_strip_resolves_when_.reason: The shared production status consumes launch.observed events, preserves the source copy, and expires confirmed running after three seconds. Native tests exercise both presentation paths through the preload event bridge.

tests.case: silently clears an unobserved launch at the original ninety-second deadline

GameLaunchTests.A_launch_that_never_star.reason: The production status expires a handed-off but unobserved launch silently at exactly ninety seconds; virtual time verifies both sides of the boundary.

GameLaunchTests.A_refusal_is_the_only_th.reason: The shared strip preserves the source refusal sentence, problem state and seven-second lifetime. Desktop and fullscreen native checks verify the ambient notice survives leaving Details and never captures pointer input.

tests.case: does not resolve the current strip for another ownership or an unconfirmed change event

GameLaunchTests.Another_games_launch_doe.reason: Only an observed event with the selected ownership identity confirms the current launch; another ownership and a dispatch-only launch.changed event leave it waiting.

detaches backend observations and rejects late callbacks when the host is disposed

GameLaunchTests.Disposing_the_strip_stop.reason: Disposal detaches the production event subscription, cancels the timer and invalidates in-flight callbacks. Retained state is no longer changed by watcher signals, matching the original lifetime contract.

detaches backend observations and rejects late callbacks when the host is disposed

FullscreenDetailsTests.Version_chooser_d.reason: Opening the real fullscreen chooser emits no action. Synthetic standard-controller Down and Accept select the second ownership; the paired backend HTTP test verifies its exact URI and launch intent. Disposed frontend callbacks cannot dispatch. Physical-controller validation remains separate.

tests.case: fullscreen controller triggers wrap local sections while opening Details never launches

FullscreenDetailsTests.Opening_details_f.reason: The real fullscreen Details initially focuses Play without dispatching. Trigger input selects Overview to Updates to Overview to Library, and returning to desktop preserves its independent initial section. The earlier controller native matrix verifies initial More when no primary action exists.
